release_notes:
- FM, Bluetooth TX power and the Device tab's identity and panic now work like Audio: each write sends only the keys you changed, so a value written from another tab or by the headset is no longer reverted.
- Write Device Info and Set Panic no longer undo each other.
- Read Device Info fills the Device, Audio, FM and Bluetooth tabs from one read. The Device tab also shows the firmware version.
- FM: if the headset has never stored its FM presets, the presets stay disabled until FM is turned on and off once. QA Helper no longer creates that key.
- Bluetooth: Upload Table and Enter Raw Table refuse a broken table (a missing field, a lost brace, or not 10 entries of 4) instead of writing it.
- After a write, burn or core dump, QA Helper waits until the headset has dropped off USB and come back before the next action. This fixes "error communicating with the device" right after a core dump.
- The log warns when the FM or Audio PS-key layout in the firmware definitions changes.
- Config folder opens the folder with the files read from the device. Folders left behind when QA Helper was not closed normally are removed at the next start.
